plan.preparation: Sequential public-development trial written after observing sentence_focus-01 (V12 cap rank 3 to 4, no bundle gain). Questions and expected lexical clauses are unchanged. This is not a locked independent evaluation.

candidate.only_change: Chunk starts at generic policy bullets, with stride fallback inside long blocks. Adjacent clauses/footnotes remain within a 900-character window. Query weights are baseline 1.0.

plan.metric_limits: D01 short-anchor presence on its annotated source/page is a lexical proxy only. A partial amount fragment cannot satisfy first-month/cost exceptions; page-only hits are insufficient. Table-cell meaning and answer accuracy are not assessed. Out-of-scope cases have Recall N/A.
plan.selection_rule: Consider an experimental candidate only if V12 cap and attached amount/cost exception bundle appear within two selected chunks, no previously complete development bundle regresses, and scope/negation/exception guards pass. No production adoption or final efficacy claim follows from this public set.
plan.next_trial_policy: Any new candidate or setting must use a distinct new output directory and disclose that earlier public-development results were observed. Never overwrite a prior run.

source_limits: Separate Dongseo bytes. Historical Jeju original and latest official corrected version remain unverified.
independence_note: Public variants share four development rule/topic groups; rows are not independent samples or human-approved gold.
